name: exercise ball wall squat
description: A squat with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball keeps the movement smooth and supports your back.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Walk your feet forward about a step and stand shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and let the ball roll down your back as you squat.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.
